answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with iris-code uniqueness: each identity binds one distinct iris code, matched by a privacy-preserving matcher that stores only a salted template, never the image. A second identity presenting the same iris collides and is rejected, so one person cannot mint many voices. Like jade graded by a single cut, timber judged from one trunk, or a mesa that stands alone, one body yields exactly one identity — cheap to verify, impossible to duplicate at scale.
